summary: The inference backends received reliability and resource-reporting improvements: llama.cpp initialization is now thread-safe, cancelled runs report when they release the backend, and GPU initialization can fall back to CPU. Speech recognition now ends an utterance when token output stops, emits one final result per utterance, and reports model memory in about:memory; related fixes also address hangs, streaming updates, and access to speech-recognition functions. Firefox also avoids trying to use Metal in the content process and improves how inference process types are represented.
